title: Electrolysis of ethylene to ethylene glycol paired with acidic CO2-to-CO conversion
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02847G, Paper

Hongjun Chen, Heejong Shin, Jianan Erick Huang, Hengzhou Liu, Rui Kai Miao, Rong Xia, Weiyan Ni, Jiaqi Yu, Yongxiang Liang, Bosi Peng, Yuanjun Chen, Guangcan Su, Ke Xie, Anita Ho-Baillie, Edward H. Sargent
A paired electrolysis system converts CO2 to CO and ethylene to ethylene glycol in acid. Using an Ru–POM mediator and gold-modified electrodes, it achieves high selectivity, stability, and improved CO2 utilization.
